verdict.rationale: Mercury has scattered AI-powered automations (bill reading/autofill, bookkeeping sync) and offers an MCP server so external AI agents/assistants can query financial data, but there's no evidence of a single built-in conversational assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to end-to-end — and the documented MCP tools are strictly read-only (no send/create actions), so true task delegation (e.g., paying bills, creating invoices) isn't supported via AI.
